args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

This change updates `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior and the test expectations:

- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")`
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (banker's rounding)

## Testing

CI passed on the `fix/bankers-rounding` branch.

## Summary

**Problem:** The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The test `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` fails under `ROUND_HALF_UP` (which yields 2.67).
